title: Affine diagonal section integration in an arbitrary vector presentation
statement: Let P,Y,d,p,aY,V,H,B,h,g,s be as in the restricted affine diagonal construction [def-pur-conventions, def-amb-affine-trace-tower, def-pur-restricted-affine-diagonal-section-trace]. For every normalized finite twist transport t and projective-line family D [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows, def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-data], every rank-d finite locally free module F on B [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section], and every isomorphism e:E(F)≅B×_V B over B carrying zero to s, let cS:C(g,s)≅C(pi_F,0_F) be the canonical section exchange over identity, precomposed with inverse identity-pullback comparison [lem-pur-dnc-section-geometry]. Then restrictedAffineDiagonalSectionTrace followed by sourceComparison.hom and nu-star(cS.hom) equals nu-star(vectorBetaInverse P B aB d F), the zero-section restriction of the actual vector integration adjunct [def-pur-orientation-refinement-comparisons]. Here aB=h followed by the inclusion V→Y and aY. No DNC specialization or beta is used.

proof.text: Normalize t to the canonical purity twist transport using ordinaryFiniteTwistTransport_unique. In the product coordinates C=restrictedAffineDiagonalCoordinates the vector presentation is e followed by C. Its image of zero is r=s followed by C. Apply affineVectorTracePresentation to this composite presentation: this is an equation of compact-support traces before taking a mate or section restriction.

Transpose this trace equation by the two Brown adjunctions. The private integration_mate_square proves this from Hom-equivalence counit formulas and the mate counit identity. Convert the affine mate with affineCounitMate_unitChange. Pull the resulting orientation square along r and the vector zero section using naturality of the inverse-image compositor (private restrict_orientation_square). orderedTatePullbackSquare supplies exactly the coefficient prefix. Derive the identity coefficient comparison from orderedTateCoefficientComposition, the left inverse-image unit law, and cancellation, as coefficient_id. This removes identity pullback on the base and yields affine_section_presentation, a completely proved private helper.

Use section_baseChange_comp_over_id for C then e to identify the direct exchange with the two section exchanges including their inverse identity-pullback factors. Apply the comparison functor nu-star. Unfold the restricted section trace once and cancel sourceComparison inverse followed by sourceComparison. The result is precisely the required map to vectorBetaInverse. No DNC family computation or normal-cone vector coordinates is used.

theorem restrictedAffineDiagonalVectorIntegration (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] (d : ℕ)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (affineTraceProjection Y d)]
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (V : Y.affineOpens)
    (H : P.AffineDiagonalGeometry (affineTraceProjection Y d) aY d V)
    (t : Etale.OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
      P.diagonalExponent_annihilates)
    (D : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T]
      (hT : IsUnit (P.diagonalExponent : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      Etale.OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
        P.diagonalExponent_annihilates t T hT) :
    letI := H.separated
    letI := H.finiteType
    letI := H.quasiCompact
    letI := H.smoothDimension
    letI := H.baseFiniteType
    letI := H.baseQuasiCompact
    letI := H.sourceSeparated
    letI := H.sourceFiniteType
    letI := H.sourceQuasiCompact
    let h := affineTraceProjection Y d ∣_ V.1
    let B := (affineTraceProjection Y d ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).toScheme
    let aB := h ≫ V.1.ι ≫ aY
    letI := P.noetherian aB
    letI := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth d h
    let g := pullback.fst h h
    let s := pullback.diagonal h
    letI := Dnc.compactifiable P g aB
    letI := Dnc.invertibleExponent P (g ≫ aB)
    ∀ (F : B.Modules) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d],
      letI := (Etale.vectorIntegration_geometry B d F).1
      letI := (Etale.vectorIntegration_geometry B d F).2.1
      letI := Dnc.compactifiable P (VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F) aB
      ∀ (e : VectorBundleZeroSection.scheme B d F ≅ pullback h h)
        (we : e.hom ≫ g = VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F)
        (ze : VectorBundleZeroSection.zero B d F ≫ e.hom = s),
        let ν := (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) B).mapDerivedCategory
        OrientationCounit.restrictedAffineDiagonalSectionTrace P Y d aY V H t D ≫
            (Dnc.sourceComparison P d g aB s).hom ≫
            ν.map (vectorModelSectionComparison P.Coefficient d g s F e we ze).hom =
          ν.map (OrientationRefinement.vectorBetaInverse P B aB d F)
